definition: One mask file per structure in each case folder. Each file is one binary mask, and masks of different files can overlap. In the 232 cases checked, every mask has the same array shape as its CT, but in 56 of them some mask headers differ from the CT header (see the quality findings). Stored as 0/1, 0/255, or signed bytes -128/127 with a NIfTI scale that maps them to 0/1; read with a loader that applies the scale and threshold at 0.5.
